about: Gamindustri – A distant world comprised of 4 nations, each under the protection of a Goddess.
Locked in the Console War, the 4 Goddesses vie for domination of the planet until Neptune is cast down and stripped of her power.
Now Neptune must fight to restore her place, but could a being known as Arfoire threaten the very world the Goddesses have sworn to protect?
• Explore the world of Gamindustri with enhanced graphics!
• Spend time catching fish and even fresh gear in this new mini-game!
• Select from 20+ characters to play from the start! Battles are amped up with up to 4 party members, HDD transformations, team attacks, and more!
summary: Personified game consoles save Gamindustri in this offbeat RPG adventure!
